name: Merton jump-diffusion delta / greeks: the Poisson-weighted Black–Scholes delta
description: Merton call delta as the Poisson-weighted mixture of chain-ruled Black–Scholes deltas, with the mixture bounded in [0,1].

code.lean:
import MathFin.BlackScholes.MertonJumpDiffusionDelta

open MathFin

/-- Merton call delta as the Poisson-weighted mixture of chain-ruled Black–Scholes deltas, with the mixture bounded in [0,1]. -/
theorem mf_merton_jd_delta {S_0 K r σ T k : ℝ} (δ : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0)
    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hk : -1 < k) :
    HasDerivAt (fun S ↦ mertonCallPrice S K r σ T k δ Λ)
        (∑' n : ℕ, Real.exp (-(Λ : ℝ)) * (Λ : ℝ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)
          * (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n / S_0)
          * deriv (fun S ↦ bsV K r (mertonVol σ δ T n) S T) (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n)) S_0
      ∧ (∑' n : ℕ, Real.exp (-(Λ : ℝ)) * (Λ : ℝ) ^ n / (n.factorial : ℝ)
          * (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n / S_0)
          * deriv (fun S ↦ bsV K r (mertonVol σ δ T n) S T) (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n))
        ∈ Set.Icc (0 : ℝ) 1 :=
  MathFin.mertonCallPrice_hasDerivAt δ Λ hS_0 hK hσ hT hk
